sources.title: Daniel M. Gordon (1994), The Prime Power Conjecture is True for n < 2,000,000
sources.coverage: Original pages 2-3: Theorems 1-8, especially planar multipliers, the exceptional multiplier bound, quadratic nonresidues, square descent, even-order and 3-divisibility restrictions. Pages 2-3 rendered and visually inspected because extracted symbols were imperfect.
sources.limitation: Checks published statements and the candidate's application hypotheses; not an independent reproof of every imported theorem.

sources.title: Gordon (2020 preprint), On difference sets with small lambda
sources.coverage: Pages 1-5: First Multiplier theorem, orbit lemma and inequalities, cyclic size bound and exception, section 3 and Table 2 bound stated in k. The nonnegative orbit-count necessity was also reconstructed independently.
sources.numbering: arXiv v1: orbit inequality Theorem 3, cyclic bound Theorem 4. Indexed publisher-version text: orbit inequality Theorem 2, cyclic bound Theorem 3, contracted extension Theorem 4.

sources.title: Alexeev-Mixon, Forbidden Sidon subsets of perfect difference sets, featuring a human-assisted proof
sources.version: v2, revised 2026-01-16, verified against arXiv record
sources.coverage: Section 4, pages 6-7: arbitrary/cyclic/Desarguesian plane distinctions and conjectural status. Adjacent construction text from an initial page extraction was not used.
sources.limitation: A source treating a conjecture as open is not proof that no subsequent paper exists; its two-billion verification claim is not treated as a best-known upper search bound.

sources.title: Peluse, An asymptotic version of the prime power conjecture for perfect difference sets
sources.coverage: Theorem 1.2 asymptotic count, Theorem 2.1 nonsquare quadratic-residue condition, section 2 multiplier statements.
sources.limitation: The asymptotic proof was not audited; the result is not an unrestricted classification.

sources.coverage: Original Theorem 1 on page 88 (PDF page 1), hypotheses and conclusion checked.
sources.limitation: Imported theorem proof not independently reconstructed; its use in the filter is a necessary condition.

sources.title: Jungnickel-Vedder (1984), On the Geometry of Planar Difference Sets
sources.coverage: Primary publisher abstract checked via web index: abelian hypothesis and even-order restriction. Square descent's exact statement and attribution checked in the full Gordon 1994 original, Theorem 6.
sources.access_result: Direct DOI open unavailable; direct ScienceDirect page returned HTTP 403. No access bypass or full original proof audit.

sources.title: Wilbrink (1985), A note on planar difference sets
sources.coverage: Primary publisher abstract checked: abelian regular automorphism group, prime p dividing order exactly once, conclusion order p for p=2 or 3; cross-checked against Gordon 1994 Theorem 8.
sources.access_result: Direct DOI open unavailable; direct ScienceDirect page returned HTTP 403. Indexed primary abstract available; original full proof not audited.
